note: The model holds none of these tools (ADR-0001). Every tool is called by code in worker/src/pipeline.ts. The matrix still matters: it bounds what a bug, a compromised dependency or a stolen credential can do.

principals.scope: R2 write to bucket ledgerline-inbox; POST to worker /enqueue only
principals.revocationPath: Cloudflare dashboard > API tokens > roll svc-ingest; worker rejects old HMAC on next request

principals.scope: read POs, goods receipts, vendor master
principals.revocationPath: accounting admin > integrations > revoke key; worker fails closed to needs_human

principals.kind: accounting API key, custom role draft-writer
principals.scope: create payment drafts; cannot approve, pay, or edit vendors
principals.revocationPath: accounting admin > integrations > revoke key; runbook step R3
mail admin > app access > remove ledgerline-reader

principals.kind: mailbox OAuth app, send-as ap@ only
principals.scope: send templated query; invoked only by a clerk action in the portal
principals.revocationPath: mail admin > app access > remove ledgerline-sender

principals.scope: approve or reject a draft; press send on a drafted query
principals.revocationPath: SSO admin > disable user; portal sessions expire in 8 h

tools.name: store_raw_email
tools.guard: size limit 25 MB; attachments only pdf

tools.name: create_payment_draft
tools.guard: refuses unless ibanStatus == match and matchStatus == matched and duplicate == false; all three written only by code

tools.name: read_supplier_reply
tools.guard: output wrapped as untrusted_reply; never sets status

tools.name: send_supplier_query
tools.guard: template ids from templates/ only; clerk-session required

tools.name: approve_draft
tools.guard: human only; no service principal holds this right
